mainEntity.name: What should I look for when hiring a general contractor for a bathroom addition in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: When hiring a general contractor for your bathroom addition in the Bay Area, prioritize experience, licensing, and local expertise. Ensure they are fully licensed and insured in California. Look for contractors with a strong portfolio of similar projects and positive client references, particularly within areas like San Mateo, Burlingame, or Redwood City. Clear communication, transparent pricing, and a detailed contract are also crucial. We provide all necessary credentials and detailed proposals to give you confidence in your choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: When hiring a Bay Area contractor for a bathroom addition, look for licensing, insurance, experience, local expertise, clear communication, and transparent pricing.
